title: The standard Cauchy density
caption: The density 1/(π(1 + x²)) has area 1/2 between −1 and 1, so P(|X| < 1) = 1/2, and P(X > 1) = 1/4. Its tails are so heavy that the mean does not exist.
alt: A bell-shaped curve with a heavy tail on each side; the area between −1 and 1 is shaded.
description: The curve peaks at 1/π ≈ 0.318 at 0 and falls only like 1/x² in the tails.
The area to the right of 1 is 1/4.
